lambda.description: Speed-care control; price of compute relative to error cost (FR-004)

force_mode.description: Operator override for experiments; ignored in production mode

verification.description: Optional verifier inputs for verifiable tasks

code_prefix.description: Prepended when the answer is only a function body

lean.description: FR-090: frozen Lean 4 statement (theorem proved by sorry) that the answer must prove; Lean decides

thinking_budget.description: Per-request System 2 reasoning budget (FR-024); defaults to the per-domain cap

show_reasoning.description: Stream System 2 reasoning tokens (marked reasoning: true)

ephemeral.description: Do not persist the conversation (evaluation and benchmark traffic)

audit.description: Force (true) or suppress (false) audit selection for a kept reply (FR-040). Default: random with probability epsilon on live, persisted traffic.

ablation_draft_conditioned.description: Coupling ablation only (ER-004): System 2 sees the System 1 draft. Rejected with 400 when disabled in configuration.

retrieve.description: FR-061: use (true) or skip (false) retrieval of earlier verified answers, quoted as delimited data with provenance; default from configuration

repair_policy.description: FR-091: repair the best-scoring candidate (Open Math Harness search) or the latest

patch_repair.description: FR-092: a code retry may answer with a Codex apply_patch to the candidate

parallel.description: FR-094: concurrent System 2 candidates per round (first verified wins)

repair_rounds.description: FR-094: repair rounds after the first (0 = fresh candidates only)

fuse_samples.description: FR-095: draw agreement samples together with the draft

hedge_after_failure.description: FR-094: first attempt alone, widen only after it fails

rescue.description: FR-096: System 1 samples verified before a failed draft is escalated
